response.query: Which empirical methods will we use to separate price effects from supply responses (retailer fixed effects, diff-in-diff, IV), and what predefined market-impact triggers/contingencies will activate?
response.answer: To separate price effects from supply responses, we use retailer fixed effects, difference-in-difference, and IV methods. Predefined market-impact triggers include significant policy changes or regulatory shifts.
